system.description:
Gained at Level 15. 3 Mana Focused Action.

For the next 3 Rounds you and your Lordling gain:

  • Your Lordling becomes Massive size.
  • Shaman and Lordling raise each other's Stats by an amount equal to their own Stats (can surpass limits).
  • Your Lordling can utilize ALL Aspects without changing form.
  • Your maximum Tactic Points is doubled (expended TP are not restored).
  • You gain access to the Spirit's Wrath and Spirit's Compassion Tactics.

Spirit's Wrath | Focused | 7 TP, 2 Stamina, 2 Mana: A massive breath attack in a 14-space line, 3 spaces wide. Deals [4×Soul] damage. Evasion Value: 15.

Spirit's Compassion | Focused | 7 TP, 2 Stamina, 2 Mana: A wave of healing. Every allied creature within 6 spaces regains 15 Health. You do not regain Health from this.
